usedFor: Each new production in Production List posts to Slack with buttons for the scouting team.

bestTemplate.name: “New Production Detected” in Production List, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new production is a lead someone must decide on, and “Send Interactive Message” collects it.

watchOut: Set filters on “New Production Detected”, or Slack gets every production and each post waits for approval.
